propositions: Auto-derive a caused_by link on bug close by resolving the fixing commit via rebar-ticket: trailer in git log, then blame the pre-fix state over file_impact to find a single-culprit commit (>50% majority) that also resolves to a ticket.
The caused_by auto-derivation uses _write_link_event direct-writer to bypass the closed-source guard, allowing the link to be written after the bug transitions to closed status.
An explicit --caused-by <id> CLI parameter and library parameter override or augment auto-derivation, and always succeed regardless of blame ambiguity.
Ambiguous blame scenarios (no file_impact, no fixing commit found, no >50% dominant commit, or no resolvable trailer) silently skip auto-derivation without blocking the close.
A strict >50% majority threshold on blamed lines across file_impact files defines the single-culprit condition; multi-commit spread or refactors are left to manual --caused-by or rebar link.
